summary: M10 frontend verification GREEN. The bottom-tab Settings has been replaced with a Profile tab (icon: person). /(main)/profile renders the full-width 320px banner with warm-cream #FFE3BD background, nickname top-left (testID profile-nickname), circular gear top-right (testID profile-settings-button → /settings), Button3D '＋ Add friends' (testID profile-add-friends-button → navigator.share with url=https://www.charrpy.com, args verified), and the OVERVIEW section with both stat cards rendering 0 by default (testID profile-stat-streak '🔥 0 Streak', testID profile-stat-xp '⚡ 0 XP'). Tab bar labels are now ['Alarms','Leaderboard','Profile'] — no 'Settings' tab. Gear opens /settings (testID settings-screen) with sections ACCOUNT (settings-profile-row, settings-delete-row) and SUPPORT (settings-help-row, settings-feedback-row) — confirmed no Version/Auth/Reset UI anywhere; footer 'Terms of Service · Privacy Policy' present. Tapping settings-help-row Linking.openURL(https://www.charrpy.com) does not crash. settings-delete-row triggers Alert.alert (RN-web Alert is a no-op popup, no window.alert fires — no crash, matches spec). settings-profile-row routes to /settings/profile (testID edit-profile-screen) — banner avatar, horizontal carousel with 19 avatar chips (testIDs edit-profile-avatar-a01..a19), nickname input (edit-profile-nickname-input), save button (edit-profile-save-button), delete link (edit-profile-delete-button), back button (edit-profile-back-button) all present. Selecting edit-profile-avatar-a05 turns its border orange (rgb(255,149,0)/rgb(184,102,0)) — selection state works. Typing 'wakebird' + tapping Save routes back; localStorage charrpy.nickname becomes '"wakebird"' and on next /(main)/profile load profile-nickname renders 'wakebird' with the matching a05 banner avatar. Regression G all green: /reward?from=math → reward-continue-button → /xp?from=math (xp-screen visible) → xp-continue-button → /(main) Alarms tab; no pageerror crashes (only the pre-existing benign autoplay-gate warning from useAlarmAudio). No SafeAreaView issues, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch packages, no red-screen. Firestore writes are correctly fire-and-forget; offline path (`getUserProfile` falls back to local cache) verified.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' fires from the SafeAreaView+View overlay using `pointerEvents="box-none"`. Cosmetic, non-blocking. References: /app/frontend/app/(main)/profile.tsx:105, /app/frontend/app/(main)/profile.tsx:108, /app/frontend/app/settings/profile.tsx:145, /app/frontend/app/settings/profile.tsx:148

action_items: Optional: migrate the four `pointerEvents="box-none"` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` in profile.tsx + settings/profile.tsx to silence the RN-web deprecation warning. Cosmetic only — does not affect behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(main)/_layout.tsx: clean migration — only three tabs declared (index/leaderboard/profile), icon map sets profile→'person'. Good.

/app/frontend/app/(main)/profile.tsx: useFocusEffect re-hydrates on tab focus so edits made in /settings/profile are reflected immediately — verified empirically (after Save, profile-nickname updates to 'wakebird' once the tab regains focus or page reloads).

/app/frontend/src/lib/userProfile.ts: getUserProfile() correctly falls back to local mirror when auth.currentUser is null OR when getDoc throws (network/CORS) — UI keeps working even when Firestore is unreachable from the web preview.

/app/frontend/src/lib/streak.ts + xp.ts: writes go to local first then `void persistStreak()` / `void persistXp()` (fire-and-forget) — UI never blocks on the network. hydrateStreakFromServer / hydrateXpFromServer use a 'server wins iff newer stamp OR same stamp and higher value' policy which is safe across offline edits.

/app/frontend/app/settings/index.tsx: Delete-account flow correctly chains deleteUserProfile() → auth.currentUser.delete() (with signOut fallback) → wipes the full local-cache key set → router.replace('/welcome'). Alarms cache is included in the wipe.
/app/frontend/app/settings/profile.tsx: Nickname validation enforces MIN=2, MAX=16, regex /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/; Save is disabled (`!validNick || saving`) until valid — good.
seed_data_creation: In-browser localStorage seeded with JSON-stringified onboarding/paywall/nickname/avatar.id values (the storage utility round-trips JSON, so raw strings produce a [storage] retrieve(parse error) warning and fall back to default — test harness must JSON.stringify when seeding).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT seeding note for future agents: /app/frontend/src/utils/storage/storage-base.ts always JSON.parses on read. When seeding via localStorage.setItem, ALWAYS JSON.stringify the value, e.g. localStorage.setItem('charrpy.nickname', JSON.stringify('earlybird')) — otherwise the storage util logs '[storage] retrieve(parse error) failed' and falls back to the default 'friend'. Profile tab testIDs: profile-screen, profile-nickname, profile-settings-button, profile-add-friends-button, profile-stat-streak, profile-stat-xp. Settings menu: settings-screen, settings-back-button, settings-profile-row, settings-delete-row, settings-help-row, settings-feedback-row. Edit profile: edit-profile-screen, edit-profile-back-button, edit-profile-nickname-input, edit-profile-save-button, edit-profile-delete-button, edit-profile-avatar-a01..a19 (19 chips). Firestore writes from web preview may warn (no project / quota) — that is expected; local cache keeps UI green. Alert.alert on RN-web is a no-op (does NOT call window.alert), so for the delete-confirm test only assert 'no crash' instead of waiting for a dialog.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no issues found beyond the cosmetic pointerEvents-prop deprecation warning.
